mechanism: Methimazole-induced agranulocytosis increases infection risk and can impair cardiac function, while flecainide has narrow therapeutic index and proarrhythmic potential that may be exacerbated by thyroid dysfunction and hematologic complications.
action: Monitor complete blood counts regularly during concurrent use; ensure thyroid function is well-controlled; assess flecainide levels and cardiac status periodically; consider alternative antiarrhythmic if agranulocytosis develops.
